'''Lluís Marín Tarroch'''{{family name footnote|lang=Catalan|Marín|Tarroch}} (born 12 October 1988) is an Andorran [[snowboarder]]. He competed for Andorra in snowboard cross at the [[Andorra at the 2010 Winter Olympics|2010]], [[Andorra at the 2014 Winter Olympics|2014]], and [[Andorra at the 2018 Winter Olympics|2018]] Winter Olympics.<ref>{{Cite web |url=http://www.vancouver2010.com/olympic-snowboard/athletes/lluis-marin-tarroch_ath1013563Lx.html |title=Vancouver 2010 Profile |access-date=13 February 2010 |archive-date=9 April 2010 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20100409025158/http://www.vancouver2010.com/olympic-snowboard/athletes/lluis-marin-tarroch_ath1013563Lx.html |url-status=live }}</ref> Marin was Andorra's flag bearer during the [[2010 Winter Olympics opening ceremony]].<ref>[http://www.coa.ad/ Tarroch named 2010 flagbearer.] {{Webarchive|url=https://web.archive.org/web/20000817092845/http://www.coa.ad/ |date=17 August 2000 }} – accessed 11 February 2010.</ref> In 2010, Tarroch failed to qualify for the head-to-head rounds of his event after falling in one of his runs and ended up in 34th place.<ref>[http://www.vancouver2010.com/olympic-snowboard/schedule-and-results/mens-snowboard-cross-qualification_sbm490900Im.html Men's Snowboard Cross – Official Qualifying] {{webarchive|url=https://web.archive.org/web/20100513204647/http://www.vancouver2010.com/olympic-snowboard/schedule-and-results/mens-snowboard-cross-qualification_sbm490900Im.html |date=13 May 2010 }}</ref>

Marín Tarroch twice finished 3rd in the World Cup: on [[2011–12 FIS Snowboard World Cup|16 March 2012]] in Italian [[Chiesa in Valmalenco|Valmalenco]] and on [[2015–16 FIS Snowboard World Cup|24 January 2016]] in German [[Feldberg, Baden-Württemberg|Feldberg]].
